item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Integralia reports that inflation rose from 4.9% to 8.4%, public investment fell 17.1%, private investment fell 8.8%, public debt rose from 44.9% to 48.9% of GDP, and Pemex production fell 11.6% between 2018 and 2022.","notes":["The supplied excerpt does not include the claims about unemployment, IMSS-affiliated jobs, or the minimum wage."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"CPJ reported that from March 2023 López Obrador sharply criticized Artículo 19, Proceso, Animal Político, Aristegui Noticias, and journalist Nayeli Roldán over reporting on alleged illegal government surveillance. The targets reported online abuse, threats, misogynistic insults, and increased insecurity; CPJ also reported that López Obrador denied illegal spyware operations and called critical media tendentious, sold, or rented. CPJ stated that Mexico was the Western Hemisphere's most violent country for journalism in 2022, with at least three journalists killed in retaliation and ten additional cases under investigation.","notes":["The claim that López Obrador did not correct alleged false information is reported as Daniel Moreno's statement, not as an independent CPJ finding."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"WOLA reported that López Obrador moved from campaign promises to return the army to its barracks toward expanding and making military public-security deployment practically permanent, placing the National Guard under Sedena operational control and proposing legislative changes that WOLA said went against the Constitution's civilian designation. WOLA also reported reduced absolute levels of some serious human-rights violations and fewer armed confrontations, but continuing excessive-force and arbitrary-deprivation-of-life cases, weak accountability, refusal to comply with an Inter-American Court oversight ruling, and insufficient attention to strengthening civilian institutions.","notes":["The excerpt supports insufficient attention to civilian-institution strengthening, not specifically insufficient investment."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E010","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A 2022 cyberattack exposed more than four million Sedena emails and exposed a serious weakness in the Army's digital security. Experts linked the weakness to austerity-related cancellation of cybersecurity equipment and technology, a general security deficiency, and too few cybersecurity officials and limited institutional capacity. López Obrador acknowledged the hack but, in the reported remarks, did not address the cybersecurity weakness or announce a remedy. The army had also received expanded state responsibilities, including customs and major infrastructure.","notes":["The excerpt does not expressly establish institutional fragmentation as a cause."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E011","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A 2023 El País opinion article argues that López Obrador expanded the armed forces' control over ports, airports, customs, security, infrastructure, and strategic enterprises, while favoring military secrecy over truth and justice for Ayotzinapa victims. It also argues that victims received inadequate accountability, the military was excessively empowered, and judicial, audit, transparency, and other autonomous institutions faced pressure or threatened budgetary and institutional weakening.","notes":["Several claims about institutional pressure and future consequences are the author's opinion and include conditional or rhetorical language; the summary is narrowed accordingly."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0047-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
